_help.drives.work: Drive root or folder where current projects live; empty = not set.
_help.drives.archive: Drive root or folder where finished projects are archived; empty = not set.
_help.drives.familyBackup: Drive root or folder of the family backup; used to report how much of the archive is already there.
_help.drives.secondCopy: Drive root or folder that holds the second copy of the archive; used to report how much is already there.
_help.drives.encrypted: Drive root or folder of the encrypted drive; empty = not set (reserved, no check uses it yet).
_help.folders.sort: Folder where new things wait to be sorted; files older than ages.sortDays are reported.
_help.folders.inbox: List of landing folders such as Downloads or Desktop; files older than ages.inboxDays are reported.
_help.photo.albumPattern: Regular expression every Lightroom album name must match (default: a date then a title).
_help.photo.albumParents: Names of the top-level Lightroom album folders allowed to hold albums; empty = not checked.
_help.photo.keepAll: Folder paths or album paths (start of the path) left out of the photo checks.
_help.video.subfolders: Subfolders every video project has; a folder holding any of them counts as a project.
_help.video.finalsFolder: Name of the subfolder that holds finished videos.
_help.video.finalsPattern: Regular expression every file name in the finals folder must match (without extension).
_help.video.secondCopyCategories: Reserved for project categories that need a second copy; not used by any check yet.
_help.cards.maxDays: Days a card may hold photos that do not yet have verified copies on two separate disks.
_help.ages.inboxDays: Days a file may sit in an inbox folder.
_help.ages.sortDays: Days a file may sit in the sort folder.
